swahili: Wafalme wa dunia hawakusadiki wala wote wakaao duniani.

english: Leaders are hung by their hands;
maragoli_luhya: 12 Avanene vasungwa kumukono gwavo.
swahili: Wakuu hutungikwa kwa mikono yao;

english: And he told them Sisera, Baraka has died
maragoli_luhya: 12 Na va volera Sisera,Baraka ma ya kudza.
swahili: Na akawaambia Sisera ,Baraka amekufa

english: Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by?
maragoli_luhya: 12 Si ki veye kindu Kya mwinye, mwinye vosi Ava vitanga?
swahili: Si kitu kwenu, enyi nyote mpitao?

english: He has bent his bow and made me the target for his arrow.
maragoli_luhya: 12 U nyiye buta bwibwe, nokuvika inze kuva kyokusera KU kyombano.
swahili: Ameupinda upinde wake, Na kinifanya niwe shabaha kwa mshale.

english: They ask their mothers, Where is grain and wine?
maragoli_luhya: 12 Va tevanga avana vavo, ubuswage be iwaini vi veye haliha?
swahili: Wao huwauliza mama zao, Zi wapi nafaka na divai?

english: Wake up, wake up, Deborah; I sing to God and thank him, wake up, wake up, sing a song
maragoli_luhya: 12 Vuka, Debora; sig ! Inze ndimbira Yahova lidzomi-a vuka,vuka, wimbe Iwimbu;
swahili: Amka, amka, Debora; mimi na mwimbia Mungu namshukuru, amka, amka imba wimbo

english: 12. A wife sitting on her husband's chair.
maragoli_luhya: 12. Mukali kwik ala kondeve yo musatsa.
swahili: 12. Bibi kuketi kwenye kiti cha bwana.

english: Young men carry millstones and children stumble under loads of wood.
maragoli_luhya: 13 Avoseli vaginga lugina na avana vekigitala netsingu.
swahili: Vijana huyachukua mawe na kusagia na watoto hujikwaa wakiwa na kuni.

english: It is because of the sins of his prophets and the iniquities of his priests.
maragoli_luhya: 13 Ga veye kigira ubwoni bwa vaprofeti veve na budamano va vasalisi veve.
swahili: Ni kwa sababu ya dhambi za manabii wake na maovu ya makuhani wake.

english: name
maragoli_luhya: eliira

english: He sent fire from above into my bones, and it overpowered me.
maragoli_luhya: 13 Ya vika muliru mu vigumba vyange ku twula migulu, nagwo vi guuta.
swahili: Aliweka mifupani mwangu moto kutoka juu mbinguni, nao umenishinda.

english: 13. Pouring water on your in-law.
maragoli_luhya: 13. Kwuhila mulam wa wovo amazi.
swahili: 13. Kumwagia shemeji wako maji.

english: Elders have stopped going to the gate.
maragoli_luhya: 14 Avakulundu va leka kutsia na kiribwa.
swahili: Wazee wameacha kwenda langoni.

english: The visions of your prophets were false and worthless.
maragoli_luhya: 14 Avaprofeti vovo VA KU koleye amalola, amalola ga vutswa na govusiru.
swahili: Manabii wako wameona maono kwa ajili yako Ya ubatili na upumbavu.

english: from Ephraim they came down
maragoli_luhya: 14 kutwula mu Efiraimu va sulunguta
swahili: kutoka Efraim walikeremka

english: And Deborah told him
maragoli_luhya: 14 Na Debora ya volera
swahili: Na Debora akamwambia

english: I have become the laughingstock of all my people, their song all day long.
maragoli_luhya: 14 Ngwiye kihenyahenye KU Avandu vange vosi, lwimbu lwavo mbasu Bei.
swahili: Nimekuwa dhihaka kwa watu wangu wote,wimbo wao mchana kutwa.

english: They wander blindly through the streets, defiled with blood.
maragoli_luhya: 14 Va voyavoya kuli vaboku mu Tsinzira va vikenywi budamano vya masahi.
swahili: Hutanga tanga njiani kama vipofu, wametiwa unajisi kwa damu.

english: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand.
maragoli_luhya: 14. Inira ya mahyolo gange, mukono gwigwe gu gi bohi.
swahili: Kongwa la makosa yangu, limefungwa na mkono wake.

english: 14. Looking at mother-in-law or father-in-law in the throat.
maragoli_luhya: 14. Kohenza navizala kumulugu.
swahili: 14. Kuangalia mama mkwe au baba mkwe kwenye mhundi.

english: And the chiefs of Issachar were together with the leaders to take the people
maragoli_luhya: 15 Avanene va iskari va li halala na tsinene tsya li bugura avandu,
swahili: 15 Na wakuu wa Isakari walikuwa pamoja na vikuu kuchukuwa watu

english: Go away! Do not touch the unclean.
maragoli_luhya: 15 Mweyahule mu tsie Ni ndiyo va kupa lwanga, budamano Mweyahule mu ta dira mba.
swahili: Ondokeni msiguse uchafu.

english: And God confused Sisera and his chariots at Ramah near Beth-el in all his chariots and all his battles, the hills of Ephraim: the children of Israel with sharp swords before Barak: They went up to go to Deborah to decide with Sisera who came down in his chariot and fled.
maragoli_luhya: 15 Na Yahova ya salanya Sisera, na ha Rama ha Beth-eli mu kivali kye-magari gege gosi,nelihe lilye lyosi, vigulu kya Efiraim: Navana va Israeli nobwogi bwekivali imbiri wa Baraka: Vanegira kutsia ku Debora kukala- na Sisera yika ku ligari lilye,na girwa.
swahili: 15 Na Mungu akawaachilia sisera na Rama kwa Beth-eli katika dunia ya magari yake yote.Na vita vya ke vyote, vilima vya Efraim watoto wa Israeli kwa makali ya upanga mbele ya Baraka: Wakapanda kwenda kwa Debora Kuamua na Sisera akashuka katika gari lake na akakimbi

english: He has filled me with bitterness, he has sated me with wormwood.
maragoli_luhya: 15 U nzizulitsi litsunwa, u nzigutidzi nekilulu kikye.
swahili: Amenijaza uchungu,amenikinaisha kwa pakanga.

english: The joy of our hearts has ceased.
maragoli_luhya: 15 Ubuyanzi bwo mwoyo getu bufweye.
swahili: Furaha ya mioyo yetu imekoma.

english: All who pass your way clap their hands at you.
maragoli_luhya: 15 vosi Ava vitanga va mu kongondera makono.
swahili: Hao watu wote waliokuwa wakipita walimpigia makofi.

english: 15. Seeing the nakedness of your father-in-law and mother-in-law.
maragoli_luhya: 15. Kolola chahonyo cha navizala wovo.
swahili: 15. Kuona uchi wa baba mkwe na mama mkwe.

english: The Lord has made all my mighty men as nothing in the midst of me.
maragoli_luhya: 15. Yahova u tungaminyi avaluviriri vange vosi hagati hange.
swahili: Bwana amewafanya mashujaa wangu si kitu kati yangu.

english: All your enemies open their mouths wide against you.
maragoli_luhya: 16 Avasigu vovo vosi va kunuye minwa gyavo ligali ku ive.
swahili: Juu adui zako wote Wamepanua vinywa vyao kwako.

english: I weep for these things; my eye, my eye runs down with water.
maragoli_luhya: 16 Inze ndiranga kigira vindu yivi, imoni yange, imoni yange, yidoolanga amadzi.
swahili: Mimi ninalia kwa sababu ya mambo haya,jicho langu, jicho langu, linatitirika machozi.

english: The crown has fallen from our heads.
maragoli_luhya: 16 Itaji yaguluki kutula ku mitwe gyetu.
swahili: Taji ya imeanguka kutoka kwa vichwa vyetu.

english: He has broken my teeth with gravel, he has covered me with ashes.
maragoli_luhya: 16 Kandi u vunanyi amino gange netsinzalo u nkuniki ligoke.
swahili: Amenivunja meno yangu kwa changarawe,amenifunika majivu.

english: The anger of the Lord has scattered them, he will regard them no more.
maragoli_luhya: 16 Livihirirwa Lya Yahova li va sundi ihale si alavahenza Kandi mba.
swahili: Hasira ya Bwana imewatenga, yeye hatawaangalia tena.

english: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me.
maragoli_luhya: 19 Nda langa avayanze vange, navutswa va ngada.
swahili: Niliwaita hao walionipenda lakini walinidanganya.

english: But they called Barak son of Abinoam to fulfill so he could pursue his own chariots from Kedesh-naphtali, and he told me about his battles reaching Harosheth of God, the Lord of Israel, not tribes but all of Sisera's battles which he gave permission and said go to the remaining hill of Tabor and take along with one man to have ten thousand children.
maragoli_luhya: 16 Navutswa Ba langa Baraka mwana wa Abinoam ku-raka ya Londerera magari zana, twula Kedesh-nafitali, na a mbolera, nelihe, lilye, kuduka Haroshethu lya Yahova, Nyasaye wa Israeli,si ya Tsihiri; nelihe lyosi lya Sisera lyaya haana munwa,na a vola, Utsie ku yuwa nobwogi bwekivali: Si ha tigala kigulu kya Taboru,na u hile halala nomundu kali mulala.nive avandu tsielfu likumi tsyavana
swahili: Lakini waliita Baraka wa Abinoam kutimiza ndio akafuatilia magari yenyewe kutoka Kedeshnafitali,na akaniambia na vita vyake kufika Haroshethu ya Mungu, bwana wa Israeli si makabila ni vita vyote vya Sisera yenye alipeana ruhusa na akasema uende kilibaki kilima cha Taboru na upeleke pamoja na mtu hata mmoja wawe na watu elfu kumi za watoto.

english: 16. Seeing a sick person and a dead person on the same day.
maragoli_luhya: 16. Kolola mulwaye nu mukuzu lidiku lilala.
swahili: 16. Kuona mgonjwa na mfu kwa siku moja.

english: There was peace with Jabin your leader who sits on the skins of Canaan until he was afflicted by those who walk to Jabin chief of Canaan
maragoli_luhya: 17 gwa li netsingulu ku Jabin mwami wa Mwinye avikalanga ku visero Kanani,kuduka iwa va dividza Nomwinye ava gendaga ku jabin mwami wa Kanani.
swahili: Ilikuwa na nguru kwa Jabin kiongozi wenu wanao keti kwenye ngozi Kanani kufika alikoteswa wanaotembea kwa Jabim mkuu wa Kanani

english: Because of this our hearts are faint.
maragoli_luhya: 17 Kigira yaga muyoyo getu gi kudzi.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya haya mioyo yetu imezimia.

english: But Sisera fled on foot to Naphtali and the children of Zebulun?
maragoli_luhya: 17 Navutswa Sisera yiruka nevilenge va Nafitali na tsyavana va Zebuloni?
swahili: Lakini Sisera akakimbia kwa miguu ya Naftali na za watoto wa Zebuloni?

english: Our eyes failed, watching vainly for our help.
maragoli_luhya: 17 Tsimoni tsyetu kuvuki kulihenza likonywa lyetu Lya vutswa.
swahili: Macho yetu yamechoka kwa kutazamia bure msaada wetu.

english: You have removed my soul far from peace, I have forgotten prosperity.
maragoli_luhya: 17 U Mali kuvika mwoyo gwange gu ve ihale nemirembe, nziviriye ligasidzwa.
swahili: Umeiweka nafsi yangu mbali na Amani, nikasahau kubarikiwa.

english: The Lord has done what he planned; he has fulfilled his word, which he decreed long ago.
maragoli_luhya: 17 Yahova u koli aga ya saavira , u dukidzi likuva lilye lya ya laga mmaduki ga kale.
swahili: Bwana ameyatenda aliyoyakusudia; amelitimiza neno lake, Aliloliamuru siku za kale.

english: Zion spreads out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her.
maragoli_luhya: 17 Zioni a nyiranga makono hehe si ha veye Kali mlala u mu leminya mwoyo.
swahili: Sayuni huinyosha mikono yake na hakuna hata mmoja wa kumfariji.

english: Father living in his child's house. (A child can live in his father's house)
maragoli_luhya: 17. Dada kwadikila munyumba yumwana. (Navutswa mwana anyala kuvugula inyumba ya ise amenyemu.)
swahili: Baba kuishi katika nyumba ya mtoto wake. (mtoto anaweza kuishi katika nyumba ya babake)

english: Because of Mount Zion which lies desolate.
maragoli_luhya: 18 Kigira kigulu Kya Zioni, yiki kyalekwa vutswa.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya mliza zayuni ulioachwa.

english: Their hearts cried out to the Lord.
maragoli_luhya: 18 Myoyo gyavo gyanira Yahova.
swahili: Mioyo yao ilimlilia Bwana.

english: And Jael put her hand
maragoli_luhya: 18 Na Jaeli ya vika mmkono gugwo.
swahili: Na Jaeli aliweka mkono wako

english: And I said my strength has perished, and my hope from the Lord.
maragoli_luhya: 18 Na Nda vola tsingulu tsyange tsi goti, na lyenya lyange kutwula ku Yahova.
swahili: Nikasema nguvu zangu zimepotea, na tumaini langu kwa Bwana.

english: They hunt our steps so that we cannot go in our streets.
maragoli_luhya: 18 Va himanga tsinduvatiru tsyetu sikunyala kugenda ku tsinzira tsyetu.
swahili: Wanatuvizia hatua zetu hata hatuwezi kwenda katika njia zetu.

english: The Lord is righteous, for I have rebelled against his commandment.
maragoli_luhya: 18 Yahova nowobulungi kigira inze nzebaaye ku lilaga lilye.
swahili: Bwana ndiye mwenye haki maan nimeiasi amri yake.

english: Father using household materials to build for his child, (a child can build using materials from his father's house)
maragoli_luhya: 18. Dada kutumikira misala jinyumba yu mwana weve kwumba kira yeye, (Navutswa mwana anyala kutumikira misala jitula kunyumba ya dada weve kwumbakira yeye.)
swahili: Baba kutumia fito za nyumba ya mwanawe kujengea yake, (mtoto anaweza kujengea fito kutoka kwa nyumba ya baba yake)

english: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens.
maragoli_luhya: 19 Ava londereranga kwinye vali netsimbiru kuvita tsindidzu tsyomwigulu.
swahili: Waliotufuatia ni wepesi kuliko tai za mbinguni.

english: You, Lord, endure forever.
maragoli_luhya: 19 Ive, o Yahova uhindiranga mihiga ne nemihiga.
swahili: Ewe Bwana unadumu milele.

english: And he told him together with you; but please give me a little water because I am thirsty
maragoli_luhya: 19 Naye ya mbo halala nive;navutwsa,ulugenda lwa lera, Mwadza,u mbe amadzi make u tsitsanga ku si lu ;la ku ha ubukumi;keke nwe; kigira mbeye nobuluhu.
swahili: Naye akamwambia pamoja nawe; lakini mwendo tafadhali nipe maji kidogo maana nina kiu

english: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches.
maragoli_luhya: 19 Vuka u kupe lwanga mbudiku mu litanga lyobulindi.
swahili: Amka ulalamike usiku, Mwanzo wa kukesha kwake.

english: Remember my affliction and my sorrow, the wormwood and bitterness.
maragoli_luhya: 19 Widzulitse lidambidzwa lyange na likenya lyange, kilulu nendulwe
swahili: Kumbuka mateso yangu na msiba wangu,uchungu na nyongo.

english: Taking fire from neighbors if you are bereaved.
maragoli_luhya: 19. Kutsia kwanzala muliru mu vatende niva ukuziywi.
swahili: 19. Kuchukua moto kwa majirani iwapo umefiwa.

english: What words have you read?
maragoli_luhya: 1Usoomi mang'anaki?
swahili: Umesoma maneno yapi ?

maragoli_luhya: 2 A liranga ligali inyinga yobudiku amaliga hehe go doolanga ku tsindama tsitye.
swahili: 2 Ataita kabisa wakati wa usiku katika matanga yake unayookota katika tama zake.

maragoli_luhya: 2 Avana va Zioni avobuguli budinyu, Ava validzwa kulengana nethahabu isiyeku.
swahili: Wana w Sayuni ni wenye thamani, Walinganao na dhahabu safi.

english: Because the leaders led in Israel, there they spread the message because the people gave themselves good and pleasing deeds
maragoli_luhya: 2 Kigira avanene avimiri mi Israeli, Ha zaa va la landidza amakuva
swahili: Kkwa sababu wakuu walitangulia katika Israeli hapo wakaeneza ujumbe kwa sababu watu wako wapeane wenyewe matendo mazuri nay a kupendeza

english: Because the leaders preceded in Israel then they spread the message because your people should give themselves good and pleasing deeds
maragoli_luhya: 2 Kigira avanene avimiri mi Israeli, Ha zaa va la landidza amakuva Kigira avandu ave haana avene gevikolwa vyobulungi vya Ya I nobulaliri,
swahili: Kkwa sababu wakuu walitangulia katika Israeli hapo wakaeneza ujumbe kwa sababu watu wako wapeane wenyewe matendo mazuri nay a kupendeza

english: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers.
maragoli_luhya: 2 Miyandu gyetu gyi girunkannyiywi kutsya ku vageni.
swahili: Urithi wetu umegeuka kuwa mali ya wageni.

english: He has led me and brought me into darkness but not into light.
maragoli_luhya: 2 Ya nzimirira nokungendidza mukisundi, si mwa li mu bulavu.
swahili: Ameniongoza na kuniendesha katika giza wala si katika nuru.

english: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob, and has not pitied.
maragoli_luhya: 2 Yahova u miri ubumenyo bwosi bwa yakobo, na si ya li netsimbavasi mba.
swahili: Bwana ameyameza makao yote ya Yakobo, na wala hakuonyesha huruma.

english: 2. Sitting on a stone for grinding grain, because you will break your back.
maragoli_luhya: 2. Kwikala ku lugina lwavasieraku, kijira ulatula mugongo.
swahili: 2. Kuketi kwenye jiwe la kusiaga nafaka, kwa sababu utapasuka mgongo.

english: What was grandmother doing in the kitchen?
maragoli_luhya: 2. Mukeere yaali naakolaki kumahiga?
swahili: .Nyanya alikuwa akifanya nini jikoni?

english: A man in his widowhood used to live in a sleeping room. A woman used to live in a cattle shed.
maragoli_luhya: 2. Mundu musatsa yakunzakalilanga ivuliri. Mundu mukali ya kunzakalilanga mu kego.
swahili: Mwanaume katika ujane wake alikuwa akiishi katika chumba cha malazi. Mwanamke naye alikuwa akiishi katika hori la ng’ombe.

english: Who did that old man call?
maragoli_luhya: 2. Nivaaha avo musakulu yalanga?
swahili: Ni kina nani Yule mzee aliita ?

english: They develop pronunciation when students are speaking
maragoli_luhya: 2.Kuvilukitsa lulimi ne limoloma lia vaana
swahili: Hukuza matamshi wakati wa kuzungumza kwa wanafunzi

english: See, O Lord, for I am in distress; my heart is troubled.
maragoli_luhya: 20 Henza, o, Yahova, kigira mbeye my lidambidzwa , mwoyo gwange gu galiki.
swahili: Angalia, Ee Bwana; maana mimi ni katika dhiki; Mtima wangu umetaabika;

english: Why do you forget us all the days?
maragoli_luhya: 20 Kigiraki u kwiviranga madiku gosi.
swahili: Mona watusahau siku zote?

english: Look, O Lord, and consider! To whom have you done this?
maragoli_luhya: 20 Lola, o, Yahova, Henza, Ni bwaha wa u koleye ndiyo!
swahili: Tazama, Bwana, uangalie, Ni nani uliyemtenda hayo!

english: The breath of our nostrils, the Lord's anointed, was taken in their pits.
maragoli_luhya: 20 Miyika gya umolo getu wa Yahova yamuvaka maguta yagumirwa mu bwongo bwavo.
swahili: Pumzi ya mianzi ya pua zetu Bwana alikamatwa katika marima yao.

english: I remember them well, and my soul is downcast within me.
maragoli_luhya: 20 Mwoyo gwange gu kidzulizanga yago, na gwinama mu inze.
swahili: Ninayakumbuka vyema, nayo nafsi yangu imezimia ndani yangu.

english: And he told him, let me go to Kedesh together with Barak
maragoli_luhya: 20 Naye ya mbolera, ive u tsia Kedesh halala na Baraka.
swahili: Naye akamwambia ,niende na Kedesh pamoja na Baraka

english: Showing others your nakedness.
maragoli_luhya: 20. Kutulamila wundi.
swahili: 20. Kuonyesha wengine uchi wako.

english: Then he went up together with him, there Jael wife of Heber
maragoli_luhya: 21 Hene yanegira halala naye yahoo Jaeli mukali wa Heberi ya
swahili: Ndipo akapanda pamoja naye hapo Jaeli mke wa Heberi

english: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets.
maragoli_luhya: 21 Muyayi nomusakulu va gonna hasi mu mahasi.
swahili: Kijana na mzee hulala chini Katika njia kuu.

english: Yet I call this to mind and therefore I have hope.
maragoli_luhya: 21 Nziyidzulitsa likuva yili, kigira yaga mbeye nelisuvira.
swahili: Hata hivyo najikumbusha neno hili na kwa hiyo ninalo tumaini.

english: O Lord, turn us back to you, and we shall return;
maragoli_luhya: 21 U ku kirunkannye ku ive, o Yahova na kula girunkannywa.
swahili: Ee Bwana, utugeuze kwako, nasi tutageuka;

english: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz.
maragoli_luhya: 21 U yanze, u sangale, o Mukana was Edom umenya mu kivala Kya Uzu.
swahili: Furahi, ushangilie, Ee binti Edomu, ukaaye katika nchi ya Usi.

english: They have heard that I sigh with no one to comfort me.
maragoli_luhya: 21 va huliye nkenyanga si ha veye nomundu Kali mulala wokuneminya mwoyo.
swahili: Wamesikia kwamba nkipiga kite hakuna hata mmoja wa kunifariji.

english: A wife who is still a guest going to the kitchen at her in-laws.
maragoli_luhya: 21. Mukali ukikiri mwiha kutsia ivwasi wa navizala.
swahili: 21. Mke ambaye bado ni mgeni kwenda jikoni kwa wakwe.

english: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.
maragoli_luhya: 22 Ga veye KU tsimbavasi tsya Yahova tsi kiranga Ni KU vula kuheridzwa, kigira tsimbavasi tsitsye si tsi gehanga mba.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya upendo mkuu wa Bwana, hatuangamii, kwa kuwa huruma zake hazikomi kamwe.

english: Your punishment is complete, O daughter of Zion, he will not exile you again.
maragoli_luhya: 22 Lihebwa mageli lyo budamano bubwo bu duki, O mukana wa Zioni si alakuhila Kandi mulyadikidzwa.
swahili: Uovu wako umetimia, Eee binti Sayuni, hatakuhamisha tena.

english: And behold, when the son of Abinoam had finished climbing the mountain. Baraka followed Sisera, Jael went to Mount Tabor
maragoli_luhya: 22 Na, henza lwa mwana wa Abinoam u mali kwanegera Baraka ya londa Sisera, Jaeli ya tsia mkigulu
swahili: Nakaangalia, kama mtoto wa Abinoam amemaliza kukwea mlima.Baraka alifuata Siseria,Jaeli akaenda kwa mlima wa Taboru

english: Unless you have rejected us completely; You are very angry with us.
maragoli_luhya: 22 Navutswa u kusuye ligali u veye nobutima bunene ku kwinye.
swahili: Isipokuwa umetukataa kabisa; Una hasira nyingi sana juu yetu.

english: You have invited as on a day of appointed feast my terrors on every side.
maragoli_luhya: 22 U langi, kuli mu lidiku lyelivugana, vyokutihidza vyange vi veye tsimbega tsyosi.
swahili: Umeziita kama katika siku ya mkutano wa makini; Hofu zangu zije pande zote.
